title: La Francophonie
description: French-speaking countries around the world - 300 million speakers across 5 continents!

sections.heading: La Francophonie - The French-Speaking World
sections.text: French is spoken by 300+ million people across 29 countries as an official language
sections.example: 5th most spoken language globally, 2nd most studied language, official language of UN, EU, NATO, Olympics

sections.heading: {Europe} - Where It All Began
sections.text: France, Belgium, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Monaco - 90 million French speakers
sections.example: {France} (67M - birthplace), Belgium (11.5M - also Dutch/German), Switzerland (8.6M - also German/Italian), {Luxembourg} (632K), Monaco (39K)

sections.heading: North America - Québec & Haiti
sections.text: 8+ million French speakers, primarily in Quebec (Canada) and Haiti
sections.example: Quebec (7.9M - '{Je me souviens}'), Haiti (11.4M - French + Creole), Louisiana (200K speakers), {Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon} (6K)

sections.heading: Africa - The Future of French!
sections.text: Africa has the MOST French speakers (60% of global total) and growing fast!
sections.example: By 2050, 85% of French speakers will be in Africa. Democratic Republic of Congo will overtake France as #1 French-speaking country!

sections.heading: West Africa - French Belt
sections.text: 11 countries where French is the official language
sections.example: Senegal (16M), {Côte d'Ivoire} (26M - economic hub), Mali (20M), Burkina Faso (21M), Niger (24M), Benin (12M), Togo (8M), Guinea (13M)

sections.heading: Central Africa - Congo Basin
sections.text: French is the lingua franca connecting hundreds of ethnic groups
sections.example: DRC (90M - 2nd largest!), Cameroon (27M - also English), Chad (16M), Congo-Brazzaville (5.5M), {CAR} (4.8M), Gabon (2.2M)

sections.heading: North Africa - Le Maghreb
sections.text: French widely spoken alongside Arabic in former French colonies
sections.example: Morocco (33% speak French), Algeria (33%), Tunisia (66%) - French used in business, education, media

sections.heading: East Africa & Islands
sections.text: French official in 7 countries and island nations
sections.example: Madagascar (28M), Rwanda (13M), Burundi (12M), Djibouti (990K), Comoros (870K), Seychelles (98K), Mauritius (1.3M)

sections.heading: Caribbean - Les Antilles
sections.text: French departments and territories in the Caribbean
sections.example: Guadeloupe (400K), Martinique (375K), French Guiana (290K) - all part of France with euros and French laws!

sections.heading: Middle East & Asia
sections.example: Lebanon (40% speak French - Paris of Middle East), Vietnam (600K - legacy of French Indochina)

sections.heading: Pacific Islands - {Polynésie Française}
sections.text: French territories across the Pacific Ocean
sections.example: French Polynesia/Tahiti (280K), New Caledonia (271K), Vanuatu (307K - French, English, Bislama official)

sections.heading: The Future is African!
sections.text: By 2050, French will have 700 million speakers - mostly due to African population growth
sections.example: DRC will have more French speakers than France! French will be Africa's most-spoken language. 85% of French speakers will be African.
